desc: Derive the two-layer state graph: state `(vertex, parity)` where parity indicates original or reversed orientation.
Verify that only reversal parity matters, so two orientation states per vertex are sufficient.
Implement adjacency lists for both outgoing and incoming original edges to support movement in each layer efficiently.
Implement implicit two-layer Dijkstra with a min-heap and Python integer distances.
Accept destination vertex `N` in either orientation and output the smaller distance.
Run and verify all provided sample cases.
